reviews.text:
I have been taking my dog “Ball Ball” to Dr. Vivian Leung since her time at her previous clinic. She care him and showed so much love and endless patience, taking the time to guide me on how to best care for a senior dog—all without ever pushing unnecessary supplements or products. He passed away at the age of 16.

She is exceptionally skilled, compassionate, and multilingual, which makes communication effortless and comfortable.

Huge congratulations to Dr. Vivian Leung on opening her new clinic! Wishing her immense success and a thriving practice! Highly recommended to anyone looking for a truly caring and trustworthy veterinarian. 🐾❤️

I'm so glad I found Langara Veterinary Clinic. I was looking for a vet who takes a more holistic or integrative approach, and Dr. Leung has been wonderful. One of my cats has a thyroid condition, and I really appreciate that she offers Traditional Chinese Medicine as an option. It means a lot to have thoughtful alternatives rather than only jumping to prescriptions. What I appreciate most is that she never pushes expensive tests or treatments. She really listens, explains her reasoning, and keeps recommendations grounded in what my cat actually needs. She's warm, attentive, and compassionate. Heather at the front desk is also amazing. She's patient, kind, and always does her best to answer my questions. I feel supported here and recommend them.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We are so grateful to have found Dr. Leung at Langara Veterinary Hospital. Our 1 year old Pomeranian recently needed a tooth extraction, which meant she had to be put under anesthesia. As nervous pet parents, we truly appreciated Dr. Leung’s kindness, diligence, and the utmost care she gave our little girl throughout the entire process.

We’ve also brought our puppy in a few other times when she suddenly decided to scare us with stomach issues, and every time, we leave the clinic feeling reassured and at ease. It’s such a comfort knowing that Dr. Leung is consistently there to care for her patients, even on Sundays!

I also want to give a special shoutout to Heather, the clinic manager. She is incredibly kind and patient with us, always taking the time to explain everything thoroughly and answer our questions. She is also so gentle and loving with our dog, which means a lot to us. And as a bonus, we really appreciate that they don't shower our dog with an excessive amount of treats just to win her over!

On top of providing excellent and compassionate care, their pricing has always been very reasonable and transparent, which we really appreciate.

Highly recommend Dr. Leung, Heather, and the team at Langara Veterinary Hospital to anyone looking for a caring, trustworthy, and reasonably priced vet. We feel very lucky to have them caring for our pup!
Thank you, Eric!
Dr. Vivien is very caring and detailed. Our Samoyed came due to an emergency and Langara Vet came highly recommended by our friend. Thank you for taking care of our furbaby Dr. Vivien!

The clinic is very clean and neat. Dr. Vi is very kind and patient. She answered every question we had. She gave my child a clear, step-by-step guide on how to give medicine to the hamster. Thank you to Dr. Vi and the team at Langara Veterinary Hospital

Great independent vet hospital. Compassionate, individualized care. Dr. Leung has gone out of her way to learn more than the average vet. I was with another vet more than 12 years but in the past few years, service declined and staff turnover increased.

My cat has cancer and was diagnosed more than 6 months ago. At that time, I switched to Langara Vet Hospital. Here Dr Leung and an oncologist have kept my cat relatively stable and amazing healthy given his advanced cancer. Strong recommendation for anyone to seek vet services here. Also, support local business owners!

Dr. Leung and Heather are fantastic. They take such good care of our dog. We lived 10 minutes away from their previous location - we now happily drive almost an hour because we trust them that much. We absolutely recommend them.

Best Vet ever! Dr. Leung and her assistant, Heather are amazing! Every visit they are so kind and gentle which makes my pup feel at home. They are very knowledgeable & accommodating to the animals needs which is helpful. I can't suggest this Vet more, you won't be disappointed!! Looking forward to being with them for many more years to come!! :)
We had a great experience with Dr. Viven. She and the clinic where really helpful specially with all the paper work to export our dog
Vet has been taking care my two dogs over 8years. I am happy and have confidence on her service. Her staffs are well trained and understand what I need.

I can't thank this animal hospital enough for how they took care of my cat, Mochi. It all started when Mochi suddenly refused to eat, and we initially thought it was just an upset stomach. Dr. Leung was incredibly patient in examining her and gave us very thorough, clear explanations every step of the way. It turned out Mochi had swallowed a foreign object — something we never would have guessed on our own.

After a careful evaluation, the surgery was performed quickly and efficiently. During Mochi's recovery, the vet techs and support staff such as Heather and Eva, were consistently gentle and attentive, which made a huge difference for both Mochi and us. Every medical procedure, medication instruction, and cost was explained clearly, so we never felt confused or anxious throughout the entire process.

They even helped us navigate the insurance claim afterward, which we really appreciated.

A heartfelt thank you to the entire team — Mochi has made a full recovery and is doing great now! I highly recommend this hospital to any pet owner looking for compassionate, professional, and transparent care.

Hi Anna, we’re unable to locate a client or patient record matching this review and believe there may have been a mix-up. We do not offer “large animal services” as we are a companion animal hospital. We’re happy to give you more specific quotes if you visit in person to discuss your pets’ needs.
Vets here are great!!! I know my pets are in great hands here
Dr Vivien was able to fit us in on short notice and provided gentle and  thorough care for cat. Highly recommended!

I am writing to strongly recommend Dr. Leung’s new veterinary clinic. Our cat has been under her care for over three years at her previous practice, and we have followed her to the new location with complete confidence.

Dr. Leung is a highly skilled and compassionate veterinarian. She successfully treated my cat for, lymphoma, and epilepsy—conditions that required persistent, precise management. Thanks to her dedication, Egg is now stable and healthy. She always explains treatment options clearly and genuinely cares about her patients.

Her new clinic is spotless, bright, and thoughtfully designed to reduce stress for pets and owners alike.

I also want to thank Eva and Heather for their warm, efficient support throughout every visit.

Without reservation, I recommend Dr. Leung and her outstanding team to anyone seeking top‑quality veterinary care.
Dr. Vivian and her team is very caring and attentive. Really appreciate the way they taking care of my dog 🐕 …

I am so glad I took my 3 young cats for their annual checkup with Vivien. Vivien and Heather were very caring and gentle with them. My tuxedo cat is usually wary of strangers but he really liked Vivien.  Vivien did a full assessment on all the three cats and found out why my Tuxedo was not eating as much as before. I am so glad we caught this before it got worse. Also, This clinic was very pragmatic and only prescribed tests that were necessary, they were thorough and explained what they were doing each step of the way. I appreciate their honesty and caring nature and will definitely be taking my cats there from now on.

Doctor Leung, Heather and their team have been caring for our rescue dog for over eight years now and we're happy to follow her to her new clinic.  Our boy has some severe anxiety around going to the vet due to traumatic experiences while living in Thailand and they have been nothing but patient and kind even when he's scared and acting out because of it (even when he's only there for something very simple/non medical like nail trims or a quick shot).  Doctor Leung is incredibly knowledgable, talks to you about your options and is always frank with us when it comes to our dog's care which we highly appreciate.  Heather is organized and very thoughtful, she often will make our dog's visit less stressful by administering his arthritis medication in the lobby so our dog doesn't even need to go further in to the clinic.   They both love animals so much and you can tell.  So long as I have a pet, Doctor Leung will have a patient.   Thank you guys!
We followed Dr. Leung from the last clinic. I only trust her to do our dog’s dental and surgery. She is wonderful - I will always recommend her!
The staff at Lanagara Vet have been amazing. Their communication and professionalism surpass any expectations you can have for a vet.

Dr. Vivien is the best and she truly cares about the well being of your fur baby. Very happy to see she opened her own practice.
Heather is fantastic practice manager, always explaining everything thoroughly, procedures and medications etc…, makes sure everything goes smoothly.

Highly recommend!

Best vet best doctor best caring in town …. My doggies been seeing Dr Vivian L forever, from their parents to their puppies gave birth, generations and generations, the torch is passed by the hands of Dr Vivian.
Congrats for the grant opening, wish you endless success and full of happy customers ard!!!

My puppy, Chilboggi is very sensitive boy.
So I often visit here. Dr. Vivian and nurse Heather always are supportive and their treatments are awesome.

We are so grateful to have found Dr. Vivian Leung. She has been caring for our dog Chowchow since she was just 3 months old, and now at 12 years old, Chowchow is still healthy, active, and happy like a puppy. That says so much about the quality of care Dr. Leung provides.

She is always kind, friendly, patient, and truly professional. She takes the time to explain everything clearly and always makes us feel comfortable and confident with her care.

Our other dog, Bunbun, is now 13 years old and absolutely trusts Dr. Leung. As pet owners, that means a lot to us. We trust her completely and honestly would not take our dogs to anyone else.

Congratulations to Dr. Leung on opening and operating her own new clinic. It is wonderful to see someone so dedicated and caring create a place where pets and their families can feel genuinely looked after. We are very happy to continue bringing both Chowchow and Bunbun to her.

Thank you, Dr. Leung, for taking such wonderful care of our dogs all these years. We really appreciate everything you do.
Dr. Leung is a very good and professional vet. We trust her and she did take good care of our pets over the years. Congregation on opening the new clinic. Wish you all the best.

My wife and I have been seeing Dr. Vivien Leung and Heather for a few years now from another practice. She's great with our rescue dog Migo. We actually moved away from where she use to be and still kept going to her, because of the care they provided. We were happy to learn that they moved closer to us and we decided to follow her. They're a great team.

My mother chose this clinic based on a friend’s recommendation, and we had a really good experience. The staff was friendly, and Dr. Vivien was kind, caring, and knowledgeable with our baby. They explained everything clearly and made us feel comfortable. Thank you again!
